scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A promising poster
scenes.caption: Reva finds a fictional scholarship poster beside the library display. It promises help with science materials. Nikhil notices a school crest, but their teacher asks them to inspect the actual request before entering anything.
scenes.speech: Reva finds a fictional scholarship poster beside the library display. It promises help with science materials. Nikhil notices a school crest, but their teacher asks them to inspect the actual request before entering anything.
scenes.dialogue: A crest is a claim to check.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: The stated purpose
scenes.caption: Their supplied school notice says the initial shortlist needs only a learner alias, class and project theme. A teacher handles later contact. The poster instead requests a home address, a password and a private family photograph.
scenes.speech: Their supplied school notice says the initial shortlist needs only a learner alias, class and project theme. A teacher handles later contact. The poster instead requests a home address, a password and a private family photograph.
scenes.dialogue: Compare each field with this stage.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: An information audit
scenes.caption: Reva marks the project theme as relevant to selection. The password has no justified role in this shortlist. Nikhil leaves the address unfilled and records the mismatch, rather than inventing a reason that the organiser might need it.
scenes.speech: Reva marks the project theme as relevant to selection. The password has no justified role in this shortlist. Nikhil leaves the address unfilled and records the mismatch, rather than inventing a reason that the organiser might need it.
scenes.dialogue: Do not supply a missing justification.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Which contact counts?
scenes.caption: The poster includes a chat button offering reassurance. Reva considers asking it whether the form is safe. Their teacher already has the school office contact from the diary, which gives them a route independent of the poster.
scenes.speech: The poster includes a chat button offering reassurance. Reva considers asking it whether the form is safe. Their teacher already has the school office contact from the diary, which gives them a route independent of the poster.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A careful conclusion
scenes.caption: They pause submission and show the audit to the teacher. The office has not yet answered. That leaves the organiser unverified; it does not prove who made the poster. Nobody needs to disclose secrets while waiting for an answer.
scenes.speech: They pause submission and show the audit to the teacher. The office has not yet answered. That leaves the organiser unverified; it does not prove who made the poster. Nobody needs to disclose secrets while waiting for an answer.
scenes.dialogue: Unknown is different from proven fraud.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: A revised form
scenes.caption: In the classroom simulation, the office supplies a corrected shortlist form. Reva and Nikhil compare its fields again. Their final evidence is a request audit, showing purpose, unnecessary fields, the independent contact and the answer still needed.
scenes.speech: In the classroom simulation, the office supplies a corrected shortlist form. Reva and Nikhil compare its fields again. Their final evidence is a request audit, showing purpose, unnecessary fields, the independent contact and the answer still needed.
scenes.dialogue: A changed form needs a fresh check.
